info.title: SageFs - F# Interactive daemon with MCP, hot reloading, and live dashboard
info.description: SageFs — a functional F# REPL, MCP server, and live web development environment.

commands.name: check
commands.description: Check environment before first run

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help message

options.name: --mcp-port
options.description: Set custom MCP server port (default: 37749)

options.name: --jupyter
options.description: Run as Jupyter kernel with given connection file

options.name: --supervised
options.description: Run under watchdog supervisor (auto-restart on crash)

options.name: --no-resume
options.description: Skip restoring previous sessions on daemon startup

options.name: --prune
options.description: Mark all stale sessions as stopped and exit

options.name: --owner-pid
options.description:
Exit when the process at PID exits (fenced by --owner-start
when given). For daemons an agent, test, or demo spawns.

options.name: --owner-start
options.description:
UTC ticks of the owner's own start time, pairs with
--owner-pid to close the pid-reuse race.

options.name: --ttl
options.description:
Self-terminate after DURATION (e.g. 30m, 1h, 90s) with no
live sessions and no MCP/SSE clients.
A small number of legacy or not-yet-wired flags are still recognized but
are refused with an explanation instead of being silently accepted — pass
one and read the error for what to do instead.
Exit codes:
sagefs check   0 = every check passed          1 = at least one check failed
sagefs stop    0 = a running daemon was stopped 1 = there was nothing to stop
Environment Variables:
SAGEFS_MCP_PORT           Override MCP server port (same as --mcp-port)
SAGEFS_BIND_HOST          Loopback bind address: localhost (default), 127.0.0.1 or ::1.
Non-loopback addresses are refused — SageFs has no authentication.
Daemon:
SageFs runs as a daemon by default. The daemon provides:
MCP server      http://localhost:37749/     (Streamable HTTP)
http://localhost:37749/sse (SSE for older clients)
Dashboard       http://localhost:37750/dashboard  (live web UI)
File watcher    Auto-reload .fs/.fsx changes via #load
Hot reload      Runtime function redefinition
The dashboard, MCP agents, and editor integrations are clients of the daemon.
If a daemon is already running, `sagefs` reports its dashboard URL.
Quick Start:
1. sagefs check                      Verify your environment (SDK, ports, fsi)
2. sagefs                            Start the daemon — it starts BARE, with no
project loaded and no session created yet
3. Open your editor (VS Code or Neovim), or visit the dashboard
4. Create a session for your project — this is the concrete next step; the
daemon does not do it for you
5. Edit an F# file and save — live test results appear automatically
Or visit http://localhost:37750/dashboard in your browser.
